req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that task ids must be strictly increasing integers. To verify this, we need: (1) a positive test confirming two consecutive creates yield id_n+1 > id_n, (2) a boundary test confirming the first new id is exactly 21 (one above the 20 pre-loaded rows), and (3) a negative/state-transition test confirming that after creating multiple tasks the sequence is strictly monotonic (no ties, no reversals). Additional tests cover exact arithmetic of the increment (+1 each time) and that the id field is an integer, catching arithmetic-mutation and type-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_two_consecutive_creates_yield_strictly_increasing_ids
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid payload to create task A
POST /tasks/ with valid payload to create task B
expected: id of task B is strictly greater than id of task A
id of task B equals id of task A plus exactly 1
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_two_consecutive_creates_yield_strictly_increasing_ids():
    payload_a = {"title": "Task Alpha", "description": "desc a", "completed": False}
    payload_b = {"title": "Task Beta", "description": "desc b", "completed": False}
    r_a = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload_a)
    assert r_a.status_code == 201
    r_b = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload_b)
    assert r_b.status_code == 201
    id_a = r_a.json()["id"]
    id_b = r_b.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id_a, int)
    assert isinstance(id_b, int)
    assert id_b > id_a
    assert id_b == id_a + 1

tests.name: test_sequence_of_five_creates_is_strictly_monotonic
actions: POST /tasks/ five times in sequence with distinct valid payloads
expected: Each successive id is exactly 1 greater than the previous
trace: STC: state transitions across multiple sequential creates
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_sequence_of_five_creates_is_strictly_monotonic():
    ids = []
    for i in range(5):
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"Seq Task {i}", "completed": False})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["id"])
    assert ids == [21, 22, 23, 24, 25]
    for j in range(1, len(ids)):
        assert ids[j] == ids[j - 1] + 1
        assert ids[j] > ids[j - 1]

tests.name: test_id_not_reused_after_delete_and_create
actions: DELETE /tasks/20 to remove the highest pre-loaded task
POST /tasks/ to create a new task
expected: New task id is 21, NOT 20 (ids are never reused; sequence is strictly increasing)
trace: R-TASK-034: strictly increasing integer ids — no reuse of deleted ids
NEG: deletion of max id must not cause the next id to regress
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_id_not_reused_after_delete_and_create():
    r_del = client.delete("/tasks/20")
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    r_new = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Post-Delete Task", "completed": False})
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    new_id = r_new.json()["id"]
    assert new_id != 20
    assert new_id == 21
    assert new_id > 20

tests.name: test_new_id_strictly_greater_than_all_preloaded_ids
expected: GET returns HTTP 200 with exactly 21 tasks
The new task id is strictly greater than every pre-loaded id (1-20)
trace: BVA: new id must exceed the boundary of 20 (the max pre-loaded id)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_new_id_strictly_greater_than_all_preloaded_ids():
    r_before = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    before_ids = [t["id"] for t in r_before.json()]
    assert len(before_ids) == 20
    assert max(before_ids) == 20
    r_new = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Greater ID Task", "completed": False})
    assert r_new.status_code == 201
    new_id = r_new.json()["id"]
    assert new_id == 21
    for existing_id in before_ids:
        assert new_id > existing_id
    r_after = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    assert len(r_after.json()) == 21

tests.name: test_invalid_payload_returns_4xx_and_no_id_assigned
actions: POST /tasks/ with empty string title (violates min_length=1)
expected: First POST returns HTTP 422 (client error, not 2xx)
No new task is created; next valid create still gets id 21
trace: R-TASK-034: error pathway — HTTP 4xx on client error
NEG: failed creates must not consume an id slot
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_invalid_payload_returns_4xx_and_no_id_assigned():
    r_missing = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "no title", "completed": False})
    assert r_missing.status_code == 422
    r_empty = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "completed": False})
    assert r_empty.status_code == 422
    r_valid = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid After Failures", "completed": False})
    assert r_valid.status_code == 201
    assert r_valid.json()["id"] == 21
